summary: A GitHub repository's poller writes each item's compact state (vcs.item.state) on change and each derived event as one keyed github.event claim. Per repository, once its plugin mirror is filled and every current fleet member advertises the GitHub plugin, a change confined to compact facts is recorded as vcs.item.state alone, without a resource.observed snapshot; a change to a fact a wake or a delivery reads still writes a snapshot. Pinned and discovered compact states read as observations; relayed plugin reads become typed.

replay.detail: No claim is rewritten or replayed. Snapshots older builds wrote stay and are read as before; compact states lay over them.

schema.detail: No new claim kind, subject family, table or storage version: vcs.item.state and github.event were registered by the previous step and are now written. The retention entry for vcs.item.state keeps no checkpoint rule, so the checkpoint rules digest is unchanged. features.github_plugin is 2 in daemon.started and /v1/health.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or rules digest changes. No coordinated upgrade: compact mode is decided per repository on each look by the poller, from what each current member advertises; until every member advertises the plugin, snapshots continue.

compatibility.detail: Contract changes C6 (write side), C7 and C8 from the db break-up plan. The poller writes vcs.item.state and github.event claims. Compact mode needs a filled mirror and every current fleet member to advertise features.github_plugin>=1. It fails closed: a member of an older build, a held one included, keeps snapshots on for every repository until it upgrades, and the poller logs each switch with the member that holds snapshots on. In compact mode, a change confined to compact facts and to facts no wake or delivery reads (per-check list, title, labels) writes no resource.observed snapshot. On members that do not poll, such an item's /v1/client/resources facts are then the compact field set over its last snapshot. Full facts come from /v1/plugins/github/*. A new item, and any change to comments, last_comment, mentions, reactions, reviews or required_checks.execution, still writes a snapshot, so exactly-once delivery across a poller move holds. A poller without a filled mirror, as after a move, treats facts that drifted under compact-only changes as a baseline. Mission discovery pins the compact state. Gates on a pinned compact state read compact fields, and a path outside them is pending. New, additive: peer client read operation GithubPluginRead (capability github-plugin version 2; the poller builds the path). Members still grant version 1 and send the path read to a version 1 poller. Tested beside the previous published release. Residual window: a member whose join has not yet reached a poller is not counted until it does; items changed only in compact mode in that window keep their last snapshot on that member until their next snapshot.

manual.detail: No operator action. Compact mode turns on for a repository only when every current member runs a build with the plugin store. The poller's log names the member that holds snapshots on (compact mode off: this member does not advertise the GitHub plugin); upgrading or removing that member turns compact mode on at the next look.

recovery.detail: Rolling back is supported. A member rolled back to a build without the plugin store stops advertising it, which turns compact mode off at every poller's next look, so snapshots resume. Items changed only in compact mode keep their last snapshot until their next change, with their compact facts in vcs.item.state claims, which that build keeps as unknown records. Rolling back to the previous plugin-store release reads those compact states over snapshots as before, and mission runs pinned to a compact state stay readable there.
